name: Remove Photo Location
tagline: Take out where and when a photo was taken before you share it.
seoTitle: Remove GPS location and EXIF data from photos
description: Remove GPS location, camera and date data from JPG, PNG and WebP photos, without losing quality. Free, and photos never leave your device.

specs.Removes: EXIF (GPS, camera, dates), XMP, IPTC and comments
specs.Quality: Lossless: the picture data is copied byte for byte
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: Phones record where each photo was taken. Anyone you send the original file to can see that, which can reveal your home, school or routine.

faq.q: Are my photos uploaded to do this?
faq.a: No. It works inside this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere. That's the point of a privacy tool.
No. Only the metadata sections are removed; the picture itself is copied exactly. Rotation from the camera may be lost, so check sideways photos.
